clips.title: The story
paras: Tal is the primary wind rider master of Thunder Bluff, tending the city's aerial roost high above the plains of Mulgore. He provides seasoned wyverns to Horde travelers looking to traverse the vast reaches of Kalimdor.

Perched upon the central mesa of Thunder Bluff, Tal manages the vital aerial thoroughfare connecting the tauren capital to the rest of the Horde. From his perch, he tends to the loyal wind riders, or wyverns, ensuring they are healthy, well-fed, and prepared for long-distance journeys across Kalimdor's rugged landscapes. Whether sending messengers down to Camp Taurajo or dispatching scouts across the Barrens to Orgrimmar, Tal maintains an indispensable lifeline that keeps the towering mesa city in constant touch with its allies.
